items.text: A new Expeditions update is live! It brings quality-of-life improvements, critical fixes, and resolves issues you reported. It will be the last update for Expeditions.
The engine turns off automatically when switching to the flying Drone control
Fixed an issue where dark spots appeared on KHAN Lo4F texture
Fixed an issue related to the TUZ 302 Capricorn skins order
Fixed several critical issues that could cause the application to crash or behave incorrectly
Added improvements to Towrope behavior in co-op
Fixed a console-only issue where the Operator (Alicia Silverwood) could not use consumables from the truck while controlling the drone
Fixed an issue related to the animations and physics of suspension wooden bridges
Fixed an issue where the suspension wooden bridge model could disappear at certain camera angles
Fixed a physics issue with pressure plates that occurred after re-entering to a map
Fixed an issue where the item placement area was displayed in red when Bruce Brown and Alicia Silverwood were selected
Fixed an issue where it was possible to place an Anchor into rocks on the Tatra maps
Fixed an issue where the “Take a birds-eye look at the old city” stage completion was not properly counted in the “Excursion” task
Fixed an issue where Photoscanning was incorrectly marked as completed when it was closed without being performed during a replay

Fixed an issue where rewards that had already been completed were displayed in green instead of gray on the Summary screen
Fixed an issue where the full requirement text was not fully displayed in the HQ menu
Fixed the “Select Attachment Point” localization string

Fixed an issue where the “Bad signal” warning for wheel drones could not be clicked with the mouse to rotate the camera
Fixed an issue where the differential lock value in the Shiba 6/J Overlander truck card in the Truck store did not match the value shown in the Customization
Fixed an issue where the Truck store is not available for opening when any car from DLC is on the top of the truck list

items.text: With Season 4: Amber Dusk, a new update is rolling in Expeditions bringing new content, quality-of-life improvements and key fixes!
2 map
2 cave (“Tatra’s caves”)
1 Indoor map
5 maps include 27 expeditions, 24 contracts, 20 tasks
-> Region: “The Tatras”;
-> Locations: “Owl Lake Ridge” and “Cat's Spine Ridge”.

Autumn mountains, recently struck by a flood, conceal many remnants of ancient civilizations. Players seeking to test their strength and courage will face swamps, floodplains, steep cliffs, and fast-flowing mountain rivers.
New content as rewards for Replayability system (1 profile frame, 1 livery, 2 decals, 2 horns)
3 trucks included in paid Season 4 content (G&S Caravan A1, Shiba Dart SR-V, ANK XM75)
1 free truck (TUZ 93 Kelpie)
2 specialists (Philip de Fitchent the manager, allows to change the contents of airdrops; Alicia Silverwood the operator, allows to install all terrain-mounted objects via a flying drone)
Barge, the new quest mechanic (winch the barge through water obstacles)
Portable Bridge, the new gadget (build bridges and overcome previously impassable obstacles)
Tow rope, the new gadget (use the tow rope to connect trucks and other objects with winch points)
The new type of obstacles - rock obstacles to be cleared using a winch
"Favorite" section for vehicles (mark vehicles as favorites, and they will be added to a separate list for easier access)
Redesigned the reward screen
Manual gearbox mode is fully independent from High Gear, and now features a 5-speed setup
Manual gears come with custom gear ratios, and fuel consumption
Manual mode now supports custom key binds for sequential and discrete gear change using mouse/keyboard, and preset key binds for sequential gear change on all gamepad control schemes
Added automatic switch to third-person view when using the winch with the first-person camera active
Added a pop-up notification about Replayability system compensation
Changed an order of consumables in the Garage
Fixed an issue where the “Vault #4” expedition was not available for deploy in the Sedona region
Fixed an issue where teleporting the Haukka NS-420 or ANK XM75 via the Helipad caused the rear suspension arms to shift, preventing these trucks from continuing to move
Fixed an issue where currency for unused items was not refunded to the player if, at the moment of leaving the expedition, the vehicle with those items was located on another map
Fixed an issue where amount of found gems displayed incorrectly on the Global map
Fixed - an issue where a towed truck pushed the lead vehicle forward when winch pulling was applied, if positioned closely
Fixed an issue where Heavy fenders were not available for installing on Loadstar 1700 SE after completing the “Trust Professionals” contract
Fixed yellow spots on the snow on the Season 2 and 3 maps
Fixed an issue where headlights turned on by pressing B instead of LB+B on the scheme C
Fixed an issue where the sound of SCT-6 scanning didn’t turn off after taking back into a truck
Fixed consumables clipping on the Haukka NS-420

Fixed an issue where the truck’s roof jittered when using the roof camera
Fixed an issue where the pre-trade window briefly appeared after switching to another vehicle, which allowed trading from any distance
Fixed an issue where shadows flickered while using the Binocular

Fixed an issue where the Metal detector installed on the Tatra 805 always rotated when the engine is turned on

items.text: As we revealed in our roadmap update, we are currently focusing on Quality of Life improvements. This update will be the last before the launch of Season 2 next month.
This update brings critical bug fixes, UI improvements and various additional changes. We hope you’ll appreciate it.
Once again, make sure to give us feedback!
Fixed a number of issues with Scheme C for gamepad
Fixed display of built bridges on the global map
Fixed the performance issue on Xbox Series in co-op mode when one of the players is using binoculars
Fixed the issue with camera inversion in the garage
Fixed the сollision with the Intelligence center base module
Highlighted quest points on the map when choosing a deployment zone
Added landmark for the drone on minimap
Added icon for installed anchors
Added the highlighting of the gatesOn the deployment screen if the expedition stage leads to another map
Added the honk button to Scheme B
Fixed a number of bugs related to controls in UI
Added the ability to open a map from a drone's HUD
Added Support of Map Mods for Coop mode
Added Functionality for Recommended Deployment zone
Added PlayStation Activities for Season 0 and Season 1
As we revealed last week in our roadmap update, we are currently focusing on Quality of Life improvements and decided to postpone the release of the Season 2.

Veteran runners have been asking for a controller scheme that is closer to SnowRunner’s. This update brings a new scheme that is much closer to SnowRunner’s Scheme A. We hope you’ll appreciate it. Don’t hesitate to give us feedback.
Another request that you had was to add a compass on the map. This has now been implemented.
Many other improvements have been made to make your experience smoother in Expeditions. You’ll find the complete details in the patch notes down below.
Once again, make sure to give us feedback on Focus Together, our community platform, so we can pinpoint where we can improve your experience.
⚙️ Main features
New gamepad control scheme based on SnowRunner’s scheme A.
Compass added on the map
The bridges that have been built on the terrain are shown on the map.
Possibility of truck recovery to any accessible outpost, including recovery between different maps
Truck’s markers on the map have been redesigned:
The markers have been moved higher to avoid overlapping with the 3D thumbnail of the truck, which caused the player to not understand the direction of the truck
The truck’s markers take on the color corresponding to the player in the co-op session and include a hint with the player's name
Tips on the Customize screen, which add-on is required to install the selected add-on
Area exploration stages have been made easier: players don't have to explore hard-to-reach places to pass a stage
When the game starts, a 3D scene of the main menu is displayed instead of static 2D art
Several UX and texts improvements related to Base modules
Collected Amethyst crystals are sold on exit to HQ
⚙️ New vehicle
KHAN 317 Sentinel

A rugged and reliable 4x4 scout vehicle designed with flexibility in mind. This pickup features a robust frame and a functional exterior with a variety of accessible addons that allow adjustments to the vehicle for both off-road performance and cargo capacity, making it ideal for both tougher terrains and long-distance expeditions.
⚙️ Bug fixes
Fixed a significant number of crashes

items.text: Hey Explorers! 🚚
We're glad to announce there has just been a new patch for Expeditions. And with every new patch, comes patch notes! ☝️
Changed flow of Task tracking. Previously, the “Start tracking” button did nothing if a task was found by Binoculars without visiting a task giver zone. The new flow is:
Find a task giver zone with the binoculars or visit a zone
The stages of the task are added to the task list on the map
The “Start tracking” button is clickable and allows the player to activate a task

Added the new tooltip about changing trucks or recovering to the Outpost. The tooltip instructs the player to open the Details menu and then either recover or change the truck. It is displayed on the imap, near the Outpost icon and the Truck icon, depending on which one is selected
The Recovery tutorial has also been updated

Significant changes have been made to the map UI, including a bug on gamepads where the Accept button did nothing without pressing any buttons on the D-pad, and a bug where the cursor was missing when opening the map after Recovery to the outpost
Headlights could be turned on by pressing right stick on gamepads

releases.displayName: Status of the game and first update

items.text: Expeditions: A MudRunner Game has officially been out for two days and we’d like to extend a huge thanks to all of you for the feedback received so far. Everyone in the team is on deck, watching streams, videos, and reading your comments and reviews.
We’re happy to see many of you enjoying Expeditions and what it’s trying to achieve, although we also are aware and understand that some of you aren’t satisfied with the game's current state.

Some of your most recurrent feedback is about UI/UX. We cannot overhaul it in one night, but this is a big focal point for the team right now, and it will be improved through several updates. Our first update releases with this message, to bring some immediate improvements.

We’re also hard at work on bug reports, and today’s patch brings a lot of fixes based on your feedback. Be assured that we’ll continue to squash as many technical issues as we can in the coming updates.
We’ve also noticed many requests for a photo mode in Expeditions, and we’re glad to add it with today’s update. It only needed a few extra days of cooking!

The co-op mode, which we talked about before launch, will be added as a free update in the coming months, as part of our regular updates to bring new content and features to the game, the same way we’ve supported SnowRunner after its release in 2020.

Co-op is an important feature, for both MudRunner veterans and newcomers. That’s why we want the multiplayer experience in Expeditions to feel as polished as possible, which means taking a few extra months.

Our intentions for Expeditions was to deliver the same amount of content as SnowRunner but with a new approach with unpaved lands, access to new gadgets and a focus on exploration. To date, Expeditions features 80 missions and over 120 side activities, spread across 9 different maps located in 3 different regions. The game has over 30km² of drivable terrain, which is the same size as SnowRunner at its launch. On top of that, we’re planning to add a lot of new content, missions, vehicles, tools, specialists, maps and more.
If you’re curious, check out our Year Pass & Editions Trailer

Finally, for those of you worried about the future of SnowRunner, we want to be clear about the fact that Expeditions offers a different experience, centered on exploration, and isn’t meant to replace SnowRunner in any way. Both games will receive updates, content and fixes over the course of the year, and we hope you’ll enjoy both for what they have to offer.
Our first update is out now on PC, and will follow next week on consoles after going through first parties certifications. You’ll find the patch notes below.
It’s only the first of a long series of updates, so please keep the feedback coming! We can be found here, as well as on social media and Discord. Our support is also ready to help here.
See you soon for a new update.
The Expeditions Team

Elements have a more comprehensible layout, both in terms of meaning and visual composition. Interactive elements have become more apparent. Additionally, improvements have been made to the car card in the store: DLC content display has been added, and layout flaws have been corrected. Now, the card precisely shows the information that is crucial for a player when adding a car to their garage.
